revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a utility-room passage with cabinets, conduits, inspection access panels, large neutral floor tiles, and warm practical interior lighting. Right-oblique view, medium-wide framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, a column or partition partly framing one side of the image.
